definitions.gloss: giant tree; great tree; large old tree
definitions.explanation: An exceptionally large tree, often old and revered. In Japan, giant trees are sometimes designated as natural monuments.

examples.japanese: ⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{巨木|きょぼく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦そびえている→そびえる：10360_sobieru⟧。
examples.english: A giant tree towers deep in the forest.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{巨木|きょぼく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{樹齢|じゅれい}→樹齢：23245_jurei⟧{千年|せんねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: This giant tree is said to be over a thousand years old.

examples.japanese: {屋久島|やくしま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縄文杉|じょうもんすぎ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{巨木|きょぼく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The Jomon cedar on Yakushima is one of the most famous giant trees in Japan.

notes:
USAGE:
Often associated with nature worship and spirituality. In Japan, particularly large or old trees at shrines are sometimes wrapped with ⟦{注連縄|しめなわ}→注連縄：06015_shimenawa⟧ (sacred rope) and revered as sacred. The word carries a sense of awe and majesty.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {巨木|きょぼく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦そびえる→そびえる：10360_sobieru⟧ (a giant tree towers)
- {巨木|きょぼく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧ (a forest of giant trees)
- ⟦{天然記念物|てんねんきねんぶつ}→天然記念物：04899_tennenkinenbutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{巨木|きょぼく} (a giant tree designated as a natural monument)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大木|たいぼく}→大木：04498_taiboku⟧: large tree — similar but slightly less dramatic
- {古木|こぼく}: old tree — emphasizes age rather than size
- ⟦{御神木|ごしんぼく}→御神木：28521_goshinboku⟧: sacred tree — a tree revered at a shrine
